turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, am I speaking with Mr. Reddy from Lucknow?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, this is he. Who is calling please?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Namaste sir, I am Ananya from the State Bank security department calling regarding your account activity.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Security department? Is there some problem with my money?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No problem at all, sir. I am just calling to confirm that the fifty thousand rupees transfer you made this morning was successful.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Oh yes, I sent that to my grandson. But why are you calling me now?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: We are making awareness calls to our senior citizens today because we have seen many frauds in your area recently.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Frauds? I am very worried now. What should I do?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Please do not worry, sir. Just remember that our bank will never call you to ask for your OTP, PIN, or Aadhaar number over the phone.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: But what if someone says they are from the bank and asks for it to fix an error?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: That is a scam, Mr. Reddy. Never share those details with anyone, even if they sound official or urgent.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I see. Thank you for telling me, beti. I will be very careful.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: You are welcome, sir. Have a wonderful day and stay safe.
